'''Recon bowcasters''' were weapons developed by [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] weaponsmiths and was a medium ranged recon version of the traditional [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcaster]]. This variant was more powerful than its lighter counterpart but still light enough for practical usage on long treks through the wilderness.

*''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]'' {{1st}}
